cpu_vs_gpu_profiling.rationale: GGML K-quantization (ggml_quantize_chunk) executes natively on CPU SIMD threads; stay on CPU runtime.

mixed_q4_k_q6_k.description: Format-matched mixed Q4_K/Q6_K with canonical llama.cpp fallback: native NVFP4 layers 0-19 use gate/up=Q4_K, down=Q5_0; native MXFP8 layers 20-23 use gate/up=Q6_K, down=Q8_0 (unpadded).

mixed_q4_k_q6_k_down_q8.description: Q4_K_M-style mixed Q4_K/Q6_K with canonical llama.cpp fallback: layers 0-19 gate/up=Q4_K, down=Q8_0 (fallback for Q6_K); layers 20-23 gate/up=Q6_K, down=Q8_0 (unpadded).

mixed_q4_k_q6_k_padded.description: Literal mixed Q4_K/Q6_K via down_proj padding 1152->1280: layers 0-19 gate/up=Q4_K, down=Q6_K; layers 20-23 gate/up/down=Q6_K.

pure_q4_k.description: Pure Q4_K with canonical llama.cpp tensor_type_fallback: gate/up=Q4_K, down=Q5_0 (exact unpadded [2304,1152] since 1152 % 256 = 128).

pure_q4_k_padded.description: Literal Q4_K on all three projections by zero-padding down_proj ne[0] from 1152 to 1280 (5 * 256); logical_shape remains [2304,1152].

pure_q4_k_q4_0.description: Strict 4.5-bpw unpadded Q4_K/Q4_0 baseline: gate/up=Q4_K, down=Q4_0 (exact unpadded [2304,1152]).
